breadcrumb.name: Abu Dhabi Toll System 2026: Complete DARB Guide & Registration

contentHtml:
The Abu Dhabi toll system has a major role in how traffic flows through the city. Expats and tourists in the UAE need to know how these toll signs work and how they differ from those in the other Emirates.

You have to set things up properly, and when you do, life in Abu Dhabi becomes much easier. We explain the Abu Dhabi toll system so you can save time while exploring Abu Dhabi or getting your rental car adventure started on the right note.

What is the Abu Dhabi Toll System (DARB)?

Abu Dhabi Toll System DARB is the official Abu Dhabi toll system. It helps manage traffic during busy hours by charging a small fee when vehicles pass through certain gates.

You don’t need to have stickers, tags, or anything stuck on your windscreen. Everything works through your vehicle plate number. So you simply have to register once, keep your wallet topped up, and you are good to go.

Understanding DARB Toll Gate System

The gates activate during specific rush hours. DARB detects when your plate number has been entered into the system and applies the standard fee. You can check your balance, passes, and activity through the app or online portal. 

DARB vs Salik: Key Differences

  1. Salik uses tags, whereas DARB doesn’t.
  2. Salik charges every time you cross a gate. DARB charges only during peak hours.
  3. DARB covers Abu Dhabi, while Salik covers Dubai.

Abu Dhabi Toll Gate System Timings

Driving timing matters here. The Abu Dhabi toll gate system timings determine when the gate is active. You will notice traffic patterns shifting during these hours because people try to adjust their travel times to avoid the fee. 

Peak Hours for DARB Toll Collection

The gates activate from 7 to 9 AM and again from 3 to 7 PM, Monday through Saturday. These windows take care of the morning and afternoon rush. Every pass during these hours applies the AED 4 fee.

Toll-Free Hours and Days

You can drive freely outside these timings. Late evenings, early mornings before sunrise, and even Sundays, the roads remain toll-free. If you’re planning family trips or long drives, this flexibility helps you move without thinking about your balance every few minutes.

Ramadan 2026 Special Timings

DARB adapts well to Ramadan timings. Exact timings can shift each year to align with peak hours and everyone’s work schedules during the month.

DARB Toll Gate Locations in Abu Dhabi

You will find the DARB gates placed at major entry and exit points across the city. These locations help manage vehicle volume coming into central areas. Most drivers learn the gates quickly because they sit on key routes used almost daily.

The Four Main Toll Gates

Abu Dhabi currently operates four main toll gates placed at strategic bridges. You will pass through them whenever you enter the island or head out of it.

Maps and Navigation Tips

Most GPS apps highlight the gates clearly. If you are using a rental car, your navigation will still show them by default. For smoother trips, always check if your destination pulls you through a peak-hour route. A small detour sometimes saves extra passes.

How to Register for Abu Dhabi Toll System

You can set everything up online, and you don’t need to return to any office or handle paperwork. This one-time setup is one of the main reasons drivers prefer DARB’s mechanics over traditional systems.

Register DARB Toll System: Step-by-Step Guide

Start with the official DARB portal. Create your account. Add your Emirates ID details. Add your vehicle. Once it syncs, your plate becomes active. The system will prompt you to load your wallet. After that, you are registered and ready to drive.

Online Registration Process

The entire registration stays digital. You will receive confirmations by SMS and email. The portal shows all activity clearly, so you can check passes, fees, payments, and updates anytime. If you are renting a car, some companies handle registration for you. So ask the company before you book the vehicle.

Registration for Multiple Vehicles

If you own more than one car, you can register all of them under the same account. Each vehicle functions with its own balance, giving you easy control without switching accounts.

DARB Toll Fees and Payment Structure

The DARB fee remains fixed at AED 4 per pass during active hours. This predictable amount makes planning easier. You always know exactly what you’re paying when crossing at those times.

Current Toll Charges (2026 Update)

The fee structure remains unchanged for 2026. One pass during peak hours, one AED 4 charge. No additional fees for multiple gates in a row.

How to Top Up Your DARB Wallet

You can top up through the DARB app, online portal, or bank cards. The top-up reflects immediately, so you never have to wait for a manual confirmation.

Auto Payment vs Manual Recharge

Auto payment lets the system refill your wallet whenever it drops below a certain amount. Manual recharge gives you full control. Most frequent drivers prefer auto payment because it avoids missed payments and prevents accidental fines.

DARB Toll System Exemptions

Some drivers don’t have to pay the toll at all. If you fall into certain categories, you can request an exemption through the portal.

Automatically Exempt Vehicles

Buses, emergency vehicles, and some official vehicles don’t pay the fee. These categories are recognized automatically by the system.

Eligible Categories for Exemption

There are exemptions available for people with disabilities, senior citizens, and limited-income categories. These applicants must apply through the portal before the exemption takes effect.

How to Apply for Exemptions

Log in to your account, choose the exemption request section, upload your documents, and wait for approval. The confirmation typically arrives through SMS.

DARB Fines and Penalties

Missing registration or driving without enough balance can lead to fines. These fines increase if ignored, so staying updated on your account helps you avoid unnecessary trouble.

Common DARB Violations

The most common issues include not registering before the first pass, insufficient wallet balance, and ignoring repeated warnings sent by SMS.

Fine Structure and Escalation

Fines increase the longer they remain unpaid. The system sends reminders, too. 

How to Check and Pay DARB Fines

You can check everything directly from the DARB app or the online portal. Payments are processed instantly, so you pay traffic fine and continue driving without delays.

DARB Mobile App and Online Portal

The DARB app simplifies your entire toll experience. Everything from balance tracking to passes shows up clearly in your dashboard.

Features of DARB Digital Platform

You can handle registration, payments, exemptions, history logs, receipts, and profile updates without visiting any office.

Downloading and Using the DARB App

The app is available on both Android and iOS. Once logged in, you’ll see quick access buttons for balance checks, recharge, vehicle management, and fines.

Conclusion

Driving in the emirate of Abu Dhabi becomes much easier once you understand how the Abu Dhabi toll system works. You can easily prevent fines, keep your account active, and stay on top of your daily travel plans.

If you are visiting or renting a vehicle from IZI rent a car, setting up your registration before your first DARB pass makes the rest of your trip smooth and worry-free.

FAQs

Is DARB the same as Salik in Abu Dhabi?

No, Salik covers Dubai using tags. Whereas DARB covers Abu Dhabi using your plate number.

Do I need to register if I only visit Abu Dhabi occasionally?

Yes, even one pass during peak hours requires registration.

How much does it cost to register for the DARB toll system?

Registration doesn’t include a fee, but you should top up your wallet before driving.

What are the Abu Dhabi toll gate system timings?

The gates activate from 7 to 9 AM and 3 to 7 PM, Monday to Saturday.

Can I use my Salik tag from Dubai in Abu Dhabi?

No, DARB does not use tags.

How do I recharge my DARB wallet?

Use the DARB app or online portal to top up instantly.
